name: Hans Stuck
features: fair skin, blond hair, light eyes, long angular face, high forehead, tall lean build, confident showman's expression
bio: 'Bergkönig', the King of the Mountains — Hans Stuck won the European Hillclimb Championship in 1930, 1931 and 1932 and again in 1934, and took the German, Swiss and Czechoslovakian Grands Prix in Auto Union's first season. He founded a racing dynasty: son Hans-Joachim and grandsons Johannes and Ferdinand all raced.
